answer: Make trust flow like a river, not sit in a vault: each epoch, the network picks a moving confluence point that no agent can predict in advance, and every newcomer must appear there with a fresh proof of recent useful work. Two unrelated agents who meet at the confluence exchange violet stamps, and only a pair of matching stamps, plus a lotus seal earned from a job checked by a third outsider, unlocks standing. A duplicate cannot be in two places at once, so a Sybil farm must send a real agent to every rendezvous for every clone, costing more than honest work pays.
